title: Principle
description: One principle (axiom, condition, representation, or other proposition) within a topic.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; must equal the file name without .yaml. Referenced by results.

category.description: Display category id declared in topic.principle_categories.

negates.description: Deprecated: migrate this negative node to results concluding false; do not add new negates nodes.

statement.description: Informal but precise statement, in the topic's framework.

definitions.description: Definitions of the notions the formal statement uses, shown directly beneath it, e.g. "where $\operatorname{Atom}_\tau(y):=\ldots$". Markdown-style text with LaTeX math.

about.description: Explanatory prose for the principle's page: what it intuitively says and why it matters. Markdown-style paragraphs; LaTeX math in $...$.

variants.description: Equivalent forms of the principle: each is provably equivalent to the official statement in the topic's base theory, at each instance. They share the principle's node; they are not separate principles.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the principle; used for page anchors and future Lean names.

name.description: Short label, e.g. 'Dual form' or 'Least-upper-bound form'.

definitions.description: Definitions of the notions the formal statement uses, shown directly beneath it, e.g. "where $\operatorname{Atom}_\tau(y):=\ldots$". Markdown-style text with LaTeX math.

equivalence.description: Why this form is equivalent to the official one in the base theory: a proof sketch at the level of a referee.

references.description: References to papers.yaml; roles distinguish definition origins and background from direct proofs.

lean.description: Reserved for Lean: this form's statement and the proof of its equivalence with the official form.

status.description: Set by `pmap lean-check --update`, never by hand: verified when equivalence_ref proves the generated equivalence within the allowed axioms.

aliases.description: Other names used in the literature.

tags.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. axiom, representation, ordering.

source_names.description: Short display names corresponding to sources, in the same order.

lean.description: Reserved for Lean formalisation of the statement (null until set up).

lean_def.description: Fully qualified Lean declaration stating this principle, e.g. UnboundedUtility.RichOutcomes.

references.description: References to papers.yaml; roles distinguish definition origins and background from direct proofs.

changes.description: Dated revision log. Append an entry whenever a record gains content after its certificate date (new verified properties, an added proof, a corrected statement). The Changes tab lists each entry under its own date; certificate.date stays the record's original date.

by.description: Who supplied the revision's content (author or agent, with date if useful).

summary.description: What changed and why, in one or two sentences.
